archive.catalogue_description: Description About: This is a map I’ve been working on for about 2 months (My first in fact). The map is modeled after my apartment, and the area surrounding it. Goal: As I had trouble creating things like easter eggs, the general goal is to just slaughter the zombies, until the buyable ending in order to escape the area. Features: -Black Ops 2 speed knifing, and lunge speed multiplied drastically. -Fixed Wonderwaffe taking away health -Buffed Kar98K (And upgraded varient) *Damage, Fire Rate, Ammo capacity -Imported weapons, and upgraded varients -Black Ops perks (Including solo quick revive) -Buyable Ending -Kino Style Teleporter -Zombie Counter CREDITS MakeCents – Custom Loading Screen and Zombie Counter YaPh1l – Type writer intro bamskater33 – Black Ops perks/tutorial Sniperbolts prefabs (Couldn’t find anyone to credit, but thinking it’s someone named Sniperbolt) ZOMB1E-KLLR – (YouTube) tutorials Aiden – Kino Style Teleporter Zombie Madness – Imported Weapons* I believe there’s something about someone who stole the scripts from an original creator. I saw the name “Rorke” referenced, so if anyone could let me know the original person to credit, that would be great. I don’t wanna give credit to someone who doesn’t deserve it. *NOTE* Just want to say thank you to everyone in the community that helped me through this whole process. Everyone who’s answer my help threads, you guys are awesome If you notice any glitches, let me know and I can get it fixed And if you’d like to visi

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
